# umami_user (Resource)

An Umami user, for self-hosted instances. The provider must be authenticated as an admin with `username` and `password`: Umami refuses API keys for managing users, and only admins can create them.

~> **Warning:** Deleting a user also deletes the websites, links and pixels it owns, with all of their analytics data. Teams it owns are deleted with their links and pixels, and their websites are left without a team, reachable only by admins. Move anything worth keeping to another user or team first.

See [documentation](https://docs.umami.is/docs/api/users) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Managing users needs an admin login; Umami refuses API keys for users.
provider "umami" {
  alias    = "admin"
  username = "admin"
  password = var.umami_admin_password
}

variable "umami_admin_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "client_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "umami_user" "client" {
  provider = umami.admin

  username = "client-example"
  password = var.client_password
  role     = "view-only"
}

resource "umami_team" "client" {
  name = "Example client"
}

resource "umami_team_member" "client" {
  team_id = umami_team.client.id
  user_id = umami_user.client.id
  role    = "team-view-only"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the user, at least 8 characters. Umami does not return passwords, so a password changed outside Terraform is not detected, and an imported user has none in state until the next apply sets it.
- `username` (String) Username, used to log in. Must be lowercase, because Umami lowercases usernames.

### Optional

- `role` (String) Global role of the user: `admin` (manage the whole instance), `user` (create websites and teams) or `view-only` (view what is shared with them). Defaults to `user`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the user ID. The password is not imported; the next apply sets it.
terraform import umami_user.client 35c22b8a-14c0-4cf8-ac51-992a875d9918
```
